div.div:
Memory Starvation Hazard:
If Worker 2 crashes and message B is dropped, the accumulator entry remains unclosed. Without strict TTL eviction, memory grows as O(λ × window).

div.div:
Head-of-Line (HoL) Blocking:
If message #1 is delayed, subsequent messages #2 and #3 cannot be emitted, even if already buffered in memory. Window capacity and timeout prevent deadlock.
